narration: The Assets registry is every machine you maintain, on one screen.
Five assets here — the Stardust Racers running operational, a Micro820 and GS10-drive bench conveyor, and the Garage Conveyor down in Lake Wales — each with its own ID and live status.
Filter by operational, warning, critical, or idle to find exactly what needs attention.
Add a new asset, export to CSV, or print QR labels — so any tech can scan a machine and pull up its full history.
